landing.heroBody: Learn to read Thai a little every day. Start with the 44 consonants, each with the word it's named after, and build from there.
landing.infoBody: ทุกๆวัน (túk túk wan) means “every day”. tuktukwan is a small place to practise the Thai script in short daily sessions: the alphabet first, then vowels and easy words.
